newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bank of Thailand chief says to make baht flexible.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Thailand chief says to make baht flexible.

text.p: Bank of Thailand Governor Rerngchai Marakanond reiterated that the central bank intends to make the baht more flexible to counter speculative attack, but said timing was crucial.
Rerngchai stressed during a television interview late on Monday night that any change would be done in a way that would least affect the baht's value.
He added that the central bank would continue to use the basket system in which the baht is pegged to major currencies in a basket dominated by the U.S. dollar.
